scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:core && bun run build:services && bun run build:cli && bun run build:dashboard
scripts.build:shared: echo 'Shared workspace packages are compiled by build:cli (root tsc) into dist/packages — no separate package build step'
scripts.build:core: echo 'Core workspace packages are compiled by build:cli (root tsc) into dist/packages — no separate package build step'
scripts.build:services: echo 'Service workspace packages are compiled by build:cli (root tsc) into dist/packages — no separate package build step'
scripts.build:cli: bun x tsc --project tsconfig.json && bun run build:node-links
scripts.build:node-links: mkdir -p dist/node_modules/@agentix && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared/utils dist/node_modules/@agentix/utils && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared/constants dist/node_modules/@agentix/constants && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared/schemas dist/node_modules/@agentix/schemas && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared/types dist/node_modules/@agentix/types && ln -sfn ../../packages/core/database dist/node_modules/@agentix/database && ln -sfn ../../packages/core/eventbus dist/node_modules/@agentix/eventbus && ln -sfn ../../packages/core/ai-harness dist/node_modules/@agentix/ai-harness && ln -sfn ../../packages/core/backup-engine dist/node_modules/@agentix/backup-engine && ln -sfn ../../packages/core/harness-adapter dist/node_modules/@agentix/harness-adapter && ln -sfn ../../packages/core/tree-engine dist/node_modules/@agentix/tree-engine && ln -sfn ../../packages/services/authority-service dist/node_modules/@agentix/authority-service && ln -sfn ../../packages/services/credential-service dist/node_modules/@agentix/credential-service && ln -sfn ../../packages/services/organization-service dist/node_modules/@agentix/organization-service && ln -sfn ../../packages/services/proof-service dist/node_modules/@agentix/proof-service && ln -sfn ../../packages/services/session-service dist/node_modules/@agentix/session-service && ln -sfn ../../packages/services/wallet-service dist/node_modules/@agentix/wallet-service && ln -sfn ../../packages/compiler dist/node_modules/@agentix/compiler && ln -sfn ../../packages/scheduler dist/node_modules/@agentix/scheduler && ln -sfn ../../packages/merkle-tree dist/node_modules/@agentix/merkle-tree && ln -sfn ../../packages/agent-manifest dist/node_modules/@agentix/agent-manifest
scripts.test: bun x tsx tests/e2e.test.ts && bun x vitest run
scripts.setup: node dist/src/index.js init && node dist/src/index.js config set rpcUrl https://sepolia.base.org && node dist/src/index.js doctor
